(declaim (inline map-permutations!))
(defun map-permutations! (function vector &optional (start 0) end)
  "Destructively permutes VECTOR[START] ... VECTOR[END-1] and applies FUNCTION
to VECTOR each time."
  (declare (vector vector))
  (labels ((recur (start end)
             (declare ((mod #.array-total-size-limit) start end))
             (if (> start end)
                 (funcall function vector)
                 (progn
                   (recur (1+ start) end)
                   (loop for i from (1+ start) below end
                         do (rotatef (aref vector start) (aref vector i))
                            (recur (1+ start) end)
                            (rotatef (aref vector start) (aref vector i)))))))
    (recur start (or end (length vector)))))

(defun calc-lis (vector order infinity &optional restore)
  "Computes the lengths of LIS. Returns a LIS as a second value when RESTORE is
true."
  (declare (vector vector))
  (let* ((end 0)
         (dp (make-array (+ 1 (length vector))
                         :element-type (array-element-type vector)
                         :initial-element infinity)))
    (declare ((integer 0 #.array-total-size-limit) end))
    (labels ((bisect (ng ok value)
               (declare ((integer -1 #.array-total-size-limit) ng ok))
               (if (<= (- ok ng) 1)
                   ok
                   (let ((mid (ash (+ ng ok) -1)))
                     (if (funcall order value (aref dp mid))
                         (bisect ng mid value)
                         (bisect mid ok value))))))
      (sb-int:dovector (x vector)
        (let ((pos (bisect -1 end x)))
          (setf (aref dp pos) x)
          (when (= end pos)
            (incf end))))
      (if restore
          (let ((res (make-array end :element-type (array-element-type vector)))
                (pos (- end 1))
                (index (- (length vector) 1)))
            (declare ((integer -1 #.most-positive-fixnum)))
            (loop
              (let ((x (aref vector index)))
                (when (and (not (funcall order x (aref dp pos)))
                           (or (= pos (- end 1))

                  (decf pos))

(declaim (inline map-permutations!))
(defun map-permutations! (function vector &optional (start 0) end)
  "Destructively permutes VECTOR[START] ... VECTOR[END-1] and applies FUNCTION
to VECTOR each time."

             (declare ((mod #.array-total-size-limit) start end))

                 (funcall function vector)

(defun calc-lis (vector order infinity &optional restore)
  "Computes the lengths of LIS. Returns a LIS as a second value when RESTORE is
true."
  (declare (vector vector))
  (let* ((end 0)
         (dp (make-array (+ 1 (length vector))
                         :element-type (array-element-type vector)
                         :initial-element infinity)))
    (declare ((integer 0 #.array-total-size-limit) end))

               (declare ((integer -1 #.array-total-size-limit) ng ok))

                         (bisect mid ok value))))))
